thread:
dina: spawning this thread to follow up on the variant-pivot RFC — we need an operator-handoff and final acceptance criteria for the pivot controller. main goals: automatic fallback that keeps session affinity, avoids cache stomps, and doesn't spike tail latency.
ben: high level q — do we want pivot decisions to be central (control plane) or local (edge/route)? central is easier to audit but slower. local is fast but we scatter logic.
carmen: i'd vote hybrid. quick local fast-path for p50/p90 blips, but central arbitration for rollout-level decisions and persistent pivots. metrics fusion at control plane.
frank: agree hybrid. For local: constraints should be tiny — only rely on a couple of signals and a short lease so we can revoke. for central: expose decision and TTL.
dina: thinking of a "variant-lease" pattern: local proxy can acquire a short lease to pivot for a session (e.g., 1–10s). control plane can issue stronger pivots with longer TTL when it sees sustained regressions. local fallback when latency/error crosses threshold.
tess: what signals exactly? latency p95, backend 5xx, and quality regression (model-score drop) all sound reasonable, but we need to avoid flapping on noisy signals.
carmen: propose metric fusion: require 2/3 signals to cross thresholds within a sliding window, plus a min-requests floor (eg >=50 reqs) before local pivot allowed. also hysteresis and exponential backoff for re-pivots.
ben: also add KV-cache-warmup concern — if we pivot too aggressively we evict caches and worsen tail. we should include a cache-warmup grace window on pivot so new variant gets traffic in slow ramp (eg 5% -> 25% -> 100% over X seconds) OR honor sticky cache keys for short time.
dina: draft policy snippet (local policy proto):
```
policy: {
  local_enabled: true,
  signals: ["p95_latency_ms", "5xx_rate", "delta_quality"],
  window_s: 30,
  min_requests: 50,
  agree_count: 2,
  lease_s: 10,
  ramp: [5,25,100],
  backoff_s: [30,120,600]
}
```
frank: love that. small nit: make lease_s configurable per route. some low-latency routes need <5s, batch endpoints can be longer.
ops-bot: deploy-check: rollout-controller v2 is in canary. metric-exporter updated to emit delta_quality. :white_check_mark:
dina: operator-handoff checklist draft: 1) on-call page with quick revert button (force-variant revert) 2) "pivot insights" dashboard showing per-variant p95, 5xx, and quality deltas + recent pivots 3) an audit log of which proxy acquired variant-lease 4) runbook steps: forced-revert -> confirm cache warming -> gradually reintroduce.
tess: runbook step wording please — ops might need exact CLI: example to force revert?
frank: add CLI in runbook: `rictl rollouts revert --id <rollout> --to <baseline> --force` and a read-only dry-run `rictl rollouts pivot --id <rollout> --variant <v> --dry-run`. include quick links to dashboards.
carmen: interface boundary discussion: control plane <-> proxy contract should be tiny: `decidePivot(session_id, signals_meta) -> {variant, lease_s, reason, idempotency_token}`. proxies must accept revokes.
dina: long-term refactor idea: extract pivot decision engine as a microservice with pluggable strategies (stateless rules, ML-based detector, manual overrides). control plane keeps global policy and audit. proxies call a local cache plus fallback engine.
ben: curious about testing: we need a chaos job that simulates DB/model regressions and verifies that local pivots + central arbitration lead to <2x tail spike and no more than 3% user-traffic deviation during canary.
ops-bot: scheduled: chaosjob/variant-pivot-smoke in staging tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
dina: risks: 1) split-brain where many proxies pivot to different variants for same session — mitigate via short leases and central reconciliation loop. 2) metric poisoning (bad deltas) — mitigate by requiring min-requests and cross-signal agreement.
frank: operational metrics to add: pivots/sec, average lease_duration, reconciliation_conflicts, rollback_count, cache_miss_after_pivot.
tess: next steps: dina to PR policy proto + runbook, ben to spec control<->proxy RPC, carmen to dashboard mockups. we'll review Thurs 15:00. :eyes:
dina: noted. thanks all — leaving thread open for any quick followups.
